service.name: Live music for baby showers and bridal showers
service.serviceType: A guitarist, a Spanish guitarist, a singer with a guitar or a jazz duo for baby showers, bridal showers and couples showers
service.description: Live music for a baby shower or a bridal shower across Denver and the Front Range: one guitarist or a jazz duo playing the standards at 65 to 72 dBA under the meal at home, in a garden or in a private dining space, a singer with a guitar taking the guest of honor's requests, and the one song the afternoon is built around learned for the day, with sound support sized to the space and one personal contact.

faqs.q: Can you play live music at a baby shower?
faqs.a: Yes. A baby shower books one guitar first, a jazz guitarist or a Spanish guitarist playing the standards under the meal at 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, in 6 by 4 feet on one circuit with a 45-minute load-in. A singer with a guitar takes the guest of honor's requests where the host wants a voice in the afternoon, and a duo covers a shower of forty in a garden.

faqs.q: What are baby shower entertainment ideas that aren't games?
faqs.a: A guitarist under the meal, so the afternoon has music in it and nobody has to do anything; a singer with a guitar taking requests from the table; one song for the mother-to-be, learned for the day and played at the table; a Spanish guitarist in the garden; or a jazz duo for a shower served as a brunch. All of them play at a volume the table talks across.

faqs.q: What entertainment works for a bridal shower?
faqs.a: A guitarist or a jazz duo playing the standards under lunch in a private dining space, a garden or a house, and a singer with a guitar playing the couple's song if the host wants it. The same duo can play the cocktail hour on the wedding day on the same contract, so the shower is also the first time the families hear the wedding's musicians.

faqs.q: Can the musician learn one song for the shower?
faqs.a: Yes. The couple's song, a lullaby or the song her mother danced to is learned for the day if it isn't already in the book, and the first learned song is included in every booking. Tell us the title with the date.

faqs.q: What does live music for a shower cost?
faqs.a: What live music costs in this market is set out on our pricing page, and the cost guide has the Colorado figures for each kind of booking. A shower is one of the smallest bookings we take, one guitarist for an afternoon, so send the date and the space and we'll come back with a configuration and a price rather than a range.

faqs.q: How loud is it, and how much space does it need?
faqs.a: 65 to 72 dBA at the nearest table, which is the level of the conversation, and a guitarist or a duo can't drift above it by accident. One guitar takes 6 by 4 feet on one circuit and a duo 8 by 6, in the corner of a dining space or under cover in a garden. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks, so the table never goes quiet.

faqs.q: Can a shower be a brunch?
faqs.a: Yes, and many are. A shower served as a brunch books the same duo restaurants book for a standing Sunday, upright bass and guitar playing the standards while the coffee keeps coming, and the brunch page covers the morning version in full.
